_about: SELECTION STUDIO · module library B (buttons, glass cards, type). Built by modules/_build.py from modules/_src/. Every file is a standalone live module: ?acc=<slug> or postMessage({acc}) re-tints it, postMessage({cmd:'play'|'pause'}) runs it.

modules.name: THE PEPTICITY BUTTON
modules.desc: The approved PEPTICITY button: see-through glass with cut corners and one slow light sweep from left to right when you point at it. In your colour it gains a lit edge and a soft glow.
modules.source: PEPTICITY brand/ui/button.css + button.js (BTN-P01, approved) with the accent hover layer from sites/dashboard-color

modules.name: MAGNET PULL
modules.desc: A slanted glass button that is pulled toward your pointer like a magnet as you come near. Its lit edge grows the closer you get, and it springs back when you leave.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-124 Magnet Pull (spring physics and proximity halo reused), re-cut as PEPTICITY chamfered glass

modules.name: LIQUID FILL
modules.desc: Glass with a little glowing liquid resting in the bottom. Point at it and the liquid rises to fill the glass, sloshing as you move, with small bubbles rising through it.
modules.source: New for PEPTICITY (Selection Studio library B); BTN-P01 glass and chamfer

modules.name: LED SWITCH
modules.desc: A small piece of hardware in frosted glass: press it and the machined metal knob clicks round one notch while a real-looking light comes on in your colour. Press again to switch it off.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard-color YOUR COLOUR selector (frosted glass body, octagonal gunmetal knob, LED lens with bloom), made into an on/off button

modules.name: CHROME BEZEL
modules.desc: Clear glass set in a polished chrome frame with two tiny screws. The shine on the chrome turns to face your pointer, the screws turn as you arrive, and the glass presses in when you click.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-109 Chrome Bezel (reflection that turns toward the pointer, turning screws), re-cut as a PEPTICITY chamfered bezel

modules.name: GLASS SLAB
modules.desc: A thick block of glass you can see the edge of. It leans toward your pointer, and when you press it the glass sinks down into its own thickness and springs back up.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-128 Glass Slab (thick edge that shows as it tilts), with a real press-in added for PEPTICITY

modules.name: EDGE STREAK
modules.desc: Point at it and the edge of the glass warms up in your colour while a narrow, bright streak of light races once along its outline from left to right.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard-color scroll-lit card halos (edge glow + left-to-right light streak, the same ring geometry), made into a button

modules.name: LETTER ROLL
modules.desc: Each letter of the label rolls up one after another like a split-flap sign, bringing in a lit copy of itself, while the arrow slides out and back in.
modules.source: New for PEPTICITY (Selection Studio library B); split-text roll on BTN-P01 glass

modules.name: TORN STUB
modules.desc: A glass ticket with a dotted tear line and a stub carrying the P. Point at it and the stub lifts; click and the stub tears off with a ragged edge, then a fresh one drops back in.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-101 Torn Stub (lift on hover, tear on click, return), re-cut as a PEPTICITY glass ticket with the approved P

modules.name: CHECK MORPH
modules.desc: Press ADD TO CART and the glass folds in to a small square, a light circles while it works, then it fills with your colour and a check mark draws itself before it opens back out.
modules.source: New for PEPTICITY (Selection Studio library B), after the dashboard submit morph; BTN-P01 glass and chamfer

modules.name: CLEAR SPOT
modules.desc: Heavily frosted glass that clears in a circle wherever you point, like wiping a misted window with a fingertip. Click and the whole pane clears for a moment.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-117 Clear Spot (frost that clears under the pointer, clears fully on click), re-cut as PEPTICITY chamfered glass

modules.name: FOCUS FRAME
modules.desc: Glass framed by camera-style corner marks that drift as if hunting for focus. Point at it and they snap tight and lock on in your colour; click and the glass flashes like a shutter.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-126 Focus Frame (hunting corner marks, lock on hover, flash on press), PEPTICITY skin

modules.name: GLASS BLINDS
modules.desc: Glass made of slim slats like window blinds. The slats near your pointer turn open to let light through and close behind you in a wave; a click flips them all in a ripple.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-130 Glass Blinds (slats that swing in a wave from the pointer), turned to vertical slats on PEPTICITY chamfered glass

modules.name: HOLD TO CONFIRM
modules.desc: For the important clicks. Press and hold: light fills the glass from left to right and the letters light up one by one. Let go early and it drains away; hold to the end and it confirms.
modules.source: New for PEPTICITY (Selection Studio library B); BTN-P01 glass and chamfer

modules.name: SHARD CORNERS
modules.desc: A plain glass bar until you point at it: two corners break off as small shards of glass that float away, leaving the PEPTICITY cut corners with a line of light along each cut. They fly back when you leave.
modules.source: APEX library BTN-102 Shard Corners (corner pieces break off as shards), re-cut so the shards reveal the PEPTICITY chamfer

modules.name: GLASS MEMBER CARD
modules.desc: The PEPTICITY member card as a thick block of frosted glass in real 3D, with the P glowing in its chip. Drag it to turn it over, flick it to spin, or tap to flip.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/main/v2/card3d.js (inlined; glyphs inline, BLACK look, tap-to-flip and accent glow added) + the approved P (brand/logo/p-mark.svg)

modules.name: SCROLL-LIT CARD
modules.desc: Glass cards that light up as they reach the middle of the screen: the edge facing the light warms in your colour and a bright streak races along the outline once. A thin light rail tracks how far you have scrolled.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard-color accent layer (card halos warmed by distance from the middle, the left-to-right streak, the light rail, the ring geometry), chipped glass from sites/dashboard

modules.name: LED SWITCH PANEL
modules.desc: The YOUR COLOUR switch as a frosted glass panel: turn the machined knob and it clicks round one notch, the light changes colour and the whole panel takes on the new colour. Or tap a colour in the list.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard-color YOUR COLOUR selector (knob, colour ticks, LED, the frosted list of colours), enlarged into a panel

modules.name: KPI GLASS CARD
modules.desc: A see-through figures card: the total counts up, the change chip flashes, and the line draws itself across the months in your colour. Move along the chart to read each month; tap to play it again.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard + dashboard-color (KPI card, count-up, delta chip flare, revenue chart in the accent, the same SAMPLE DATA)

modules.name: PRODUCT GLASS CARD
modules.desc: A see-through product card with the PEPTICITY bottle standing in a pool of light. Point at it and the bottle lifts while a line of light rises up through the glass. Pick a size, then add it to the cart.
modules.source: PEPTICITY store card (sites/main/v2: the Higgsfield bottle assets/vial-pepticity.webp with the rising shine), BTN-P01 button, product name and sizes from shared/inventory.js

modules.name: TODAY'S WORD
modules.desc: One short line a day on a glass card. The words drift in out of a soft blur, a slow light passes across the glass and its edge breathes in your colour. Save the ones you like, or tap NEXT to see another.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard-color TODAY'S WORD card (shine, accent breath, word-by-word entrance, SAVE heart, phone switch, the original lines)

modules.name: CHIPPED-CORNER GLASS
modules.desc: The dashboard's glass cards with their corners chipped off at different angles. Point at one: it lifts and leans toward you, its outline lights in your colour and a spark of light runs down each cut corner.
modules.source: PEPTICITY sites/dashboard glass cards (.glass[data-sh] chipped corners, grain, tone, tilt and lift) with the accent edge from sites/dashboard-color

modules.name: LIQUID GLASS
modules.desc: A slab of perfectly clear glass that really bends the moving smoke behind it, strongest at its cut edges. Move over it and a drop of liquid glass follows your pointer, magnifying whatever is under it.
modules.source: New for PEPTICITY (Selection Studio library B): real refraction of the BG-P01 silver smoke ground (brand/ui/smoke-bg.js) through the PEPTICITY chamfer, drop lens after APEX liquid-glass-studio

modules.name: TILT PARALLAX
modules.desc: A glass card built in layers: the frosted plate at the back, the P floating in front of it, the bottle in front of that and the words nearest to you. Tilt it with your pointer and the layers slide past each other in real depth.
modules.source: New for PEPTICITY (Selection Studio library B): layered depth with the approved P (brand/logo/p-mark.svg, gunmetal) and the Higgsfield bottle (assets/vial-pepticity.webp); tilt with glare from premium-micro-interactions

modules.name: STACKED DECK
modules.desc: Four glass cards in a neat stack. Point at the stack and they fan out like a hand of cards; point at one to lift it. Click to deal the top card to the back of the deck.
modules.source: APEX library CRD-127 Fanned Deck (fan on hover, deal on click), re-cut as PEPTICITY chamfered glass

modules.name: FOG WIPE
modules.desc: A misted pane of glass. Wipe it with your pointer or finger and the words underneath come through sharp; leave it and the mist slowly creeps back. A button clears it all at once.
modules.source: APEX library CRD-124 Fog Wipe (wipe to clear, fog returns, clear button), re-cut as PEPTICITY chamfered glass with a sample order

modules.name: HINGED DOORS
modules.desc: Two glass doors on polished hinges with the P split across them and a thin line of light where they meet. Tap and they swing open to reveal a members' sign-up inside; tap again to close them.
modules.source: APEX library CRD-130 Hinged Doors (glass doors that swing open on chrome hinges to a short form), re-cut with the approved P and PEPTICITY chamfers

modules.name: PEPTICITY STUDIO 3D
modules.desc: The approved PEPTICITY lettering, live in real 3D: matte gunmetal faces, dark sides with a faint violet sheen and a hairline of light on every edge. The letters turn into place, lean toward your pointer, and turn again as you drag across them.
modules.source: PEPTICITY brand/font/type3d-engine.js + glyphs.json (commit 6de50ec), set exactly as sites/brand-font section 02 (PEPTICITY fill .84 funky 1, STUDIO fill .6 funky .8, dark wall, same light); BTN-P01 button

modules.name: PEPTICITY BLACK FLAT
modules.desc: The PEPTICITY lettering as a flat typeface in brushed gunmetal: the same wide, sharp-cornered capitals, light enough for every heading. Letters rise in, lift toward your pointer, and a line of light passes over the headline.
modules.source: PEPTICITY brand/font/PepticityBlack.woff2 (commit 6de50ec); the heading light pass from sites/dashboard-color; BTN-P01 button

modules.name: PEPTICITY BLACK CONDENSED
modules.desc: The narrow sister cut: the same weight in a slimmer body, so long names fit on a bottle, a label or a phone. Shown running up the side like the bottle label, with light rising through it; the headline letters stretch as you pass over them.
modules.source: PEPTICITY brand/font/PepticityBlackCondensed.woff2 (commit 6de50ec), vertical setting after the PEPTICITY bottle label (brand/vial-hf); BTN-P01 button

modules.name: PEPTICITY BLACK SPLIT
modules.desc: The sister cut with a hairline seam through every letter. Point at the word and the letters open along that seam, letting a line of light in your colour show through; a slow light also runs along the seam on its own.
modules.source: PEPTICITY brand/font/PepticityBlackSplit.woff2 (commit 6de50ec); BTN-P01 button

modules.name: 3D HEADLINE + BODY
modules.desc: How a real page reads: the 3D PEPTICITY lettering floats straight on the moving background as the headline, with calm, easy-to-read body text and small labels under it. The headline leans toward your pointer.
modules.source: PEPTICITY brand/font/type3d-engine.js (approved materials and edge light, shown without the wall so it floats on the BG-P01 smoke) paired with Geist body and Geist Mono labels (as on sites/brand-font); BTN-P01 button
